Danmarks Statistik is the national statistical organization of Denmark, serving as a critical data provider for healthcare and educational quality reporting. In the context of the annual quality report for ADHD pathways in the Danish healthcare system, Danmarks Statistik acts as the source organization for national exam data [^src1]. This data is specifically utilized to calculate [[indikator-7a|Indikator 7a]] and [[indikator-7b|Indikator 7b]], which measure the completion of primary school exit exams before the age of 17 for youth with ADHD [^src1].

The reliance on Danmarks Statistik ensures high data completeness for these educational indicators, as the organization registers all exam results from public primary schools (*folkeskoler*) across Denmark [^src1]. By providing this comprehensive national dataset, Danmarks Statistik enables systematic comparisons between the ADHD diagnostic and treatment populations and the general background population. This data infrastructure is essential for highlighting regional differences and structural educational disparities, ultimately informing targeted support strategies within the school system and clinical treatment pathways [^src1].
